sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE date(crash_date)='2026-07-01' AND weather_condition='CLEAR'
SELECT DISTINCT make FROM vehicles WHERE vehicle_year = 2011
SELECT SUM(injuries_total) FROM crashes WHERE street_name = 'FULLERTON AVE'
SELECT crash_type, COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE lighting_condition='DARKNESS, LIGHTED ROAD' GROUP BY crash_type
SELECT AVG(posted_speed_limit) FROM crashes WHERE street_name = 'WESTERN AVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE traffic_control_device='TRAFFIC SIGNAL' AND device_condition='FUNCTIONING PROPERLY'
SELECT prim_contributory_cause, COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE injuries_incapacitating > 0 GROUP BY prim_contributory_cause
SELECT DISTINCT prim_contributory_cause FROM crashes WHERE hit_and_run_i = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE street_name = 'WESTERN AVE' AND lighting_condition = 'DARKNESS, LIGHTED ROAD'
SELECT p.person_type, COUNT(*) FROM people p JOIN crashes c ON p.crash_record_id=c.crash_record_id WHERE c.street_name='WESTERN AVE' GROUP BY p.person_type

SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vehicles v WHERE v.crash_record_id=c.crash_record_id AND v.towed_i='Y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM crashes c WHERE street_name='FULLERTON AVE'
SELECT MAX(posted_speed_limit) FROM crashes WHERE street_name = 'FULLERTON AVE'
SELECT DISTINCT model FROM vehicles WHERE make='TOYOTA' ORDER BY model
SELECT roadway_surface_cond, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crashes WHERE posted_speed_limit = 30 GROUP BY roadway_surface_cond ORDER BY cnt DESC, roadway_surface_cond
SELECT make, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM vehicles WHERE occupant_cnt = 1 GROUP BY make ORDER BY cnt DESC, make
SELECT crash_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crashes WHERE injuries_total > 0 GROUP BY crash_type ORDER BY cnt DESC, crash_type
SELECT person_type, COUNT(*) FROM people WHERE age < 30 GROUP BY person_type ORDER BY person_type
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE damage = 'OVER $1,500'
SELECT v.make, COUNT(*) FROM vehicles v JOIN crashes c ON v.crash_record_id=c.crash_record_id WHERE c.posted_speed_limit=30 GROUP BY v.make
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) FROM people p JOIN vehicles v ON p.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id WHERE p.person_type='DRIVER' AND v.make='TOYOTA'
SELECT street_name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(hit_and_run_i='Y')/COUNT(*),2) AS hit_and_run_pct FROM crashes GROUP BY street_name HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 ORDER BY hit_and_run_pct DESC, street_name

WITH t AS (SELECT street_name, SUM(injuries_total) AS total FROM crashes GROUP BY street_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1) SELECT street_name, total FROM t WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM t) ORDER BY total DESC, street_name

SELECT c.crash_date, COUNT(v.crash_unit_id) AS vehicle_count FROM crashes c LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON v.crash_record_id=c.crash_record_id WHERE c.street_name='WESTERN AVE' GROUP BY c.crash_record_id ORDER BY c.crash_date
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN hit_and_run_i='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM crashes WHERE crash_date LIKE '2026-07-01%'

SELECT cc.category, CAST(SUM(c.crash_type='INJURY AND / OR TOW DUE TO CRASH') AS REAL)/COUNT(*) AS injury_crash_rate FROM crashes c JOIN contributory_causes cc ON c.prim_contributory_cause=cc.cause GROUP BY cc.category ORDER BY injury_crash_rate DESC, cc.category
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE primary_type = 'HOMICIDE' AND arrest = 0
SELECT case_number, crime_date FROM crimes WHERE location_description = 'HOUSE' AND year = 2026 ORDER BY crime_date, crime_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT beat) FROM crimes WHERE primary_type='HOMICIDE' AND location_description='HOUSE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE primary_type='HOMICIDE' AND location_description='STREET'

SELECT ca.community_area_name, COUNT(*) AS crime_count FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON c.community_area_id = ca.community_area_id WHERE c.location_description = 'RESIDENCE' GROUP BY ca.community_area_name ORDER BY crime_count DESC, ca.community_area_name
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT case_number) FROM crimes WHERE iucr='0110' AND domestic=1
SELECT i.primary_description, COUNT(*) FROM crimes c JOIN iucr_codes i ON c.iucr=i.iucr WHERE i.index_code='N' GROUP BY i.primary_description

SELECT p.district_label, SUM(CASE WHEN c.arrest=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS arrests, SUM(CASE WHEN c.arrest=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_arrests FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts p ON c.district_id=p.district_id GROUP BY p.district_label ORDER BY p.district_label
SELECT fbi_code, SUM(CASE WHEN domestic = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS domestic_count, SUM(CASE WHEN domestic = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_domestic_count FROM crimes GROUP BY fbi_code

SELECT ca.community_area_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(c.arrest) AS REAL)/COUNT(*),3) AS arrest_rate FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON c.community_area_id=ca.community_area_id GROUP BY ca.community_area_name HAVING COUNT(*)>=10 ORDER BY arrest_rate DESC, ca.community_area_name

SELECT district_label, case_number, crime_date FROM (SELECT p.district_label, c.case_number, c.crime_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.district_id ORDER BY c.crime_date DESC, c.case_number ASC) rn FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts p ON c.district_id=p.district_id) WHERE rn=1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT community_area_id) FROM crimes WHERE primary_type='HOMICIDE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE district_id = 24
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE domestic = 1 AND arrest = 1
SELECT MIN(crime_date) FROM crimes WHERE primary_type='HOMICIDE'
SELECT ward, COUNT(*) AS arrest_count FROM crimes WHERE arrest = 1 GROUP BY ward ORDER BY ward

SELECT c.iucr, i.primary_description, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crimes c JOIN iucr_codes i ON c.iucr=i.iucr WHERE c.location_description='STREET' AND c.arrest=1 GROUP BY c.iucr, i.primary_description ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.iucr

WITH c AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.district_label, ca.community_area_name, COUNT(*) n FROM crimes cr JOIN police_districts d ON d.district_id=cr.district_id JOIN community_areas ca ON ca.community_area_id=cr.community_area_id GROUP BY d.district_id, ca.community_area_id),
r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY district_id ORDER BY n DESC, community_area_name) rn FROM c)
SELECT district_label, community_area_name, n FROM r WHERE rn=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE ward = 50 AND domestic = 0
SELECT iucr, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w',crime_date) IN ('0','6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct FROM crimes GROUP BY iucr HAVING COUNT(*)>=10 ORDER BY pct DESC, iucr
SELECT MAX(updated_on) FROM crimes WHERE iucr = '0110'

SELECT ca.community_area_name, SUM(substr(c.crime_date,1,10) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-07') w1, SUM(substr(c.crime_date,1,10) BETWEEN '2026-07-08' AND '2026-07-14') w2, SUM(substr(c.crime_date,1,10) BETWEEN '2026-07-08' AND '2026-07-14') - SUM(substr(c.crime_date,1,10) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-07') diff FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON ca.community_area_id=c.community_area_id WHERE substr(c.crime_date,1,10) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-14' GROUP BY ca.community_area_name ORDER BY diff DESC, ca.community_area_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas a ON c.community_area_id = a.community_area_id WHERE a.community_area_name = 'WEST RIDGE';
SELECT i.index_code, COUNT(*) AS crime_count FROM crimes c JOIN iucr_codes i ON c.iucr=i.iucr GROUP BY i.index_code

SELECT ca.community_area_name, COUNT(*) AS domestic_count FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON c.community_area_id=ca.community_area_id WHERE c.domestic=1 GROUP BY ca.community_area_name ORDER BY domestic_count DESC, ca.community_area_name
SELECT p.district_label, COUNT(c.crime_id) FROM police_districts p LEFT JOIN crimes c ON c.district_id=p.district_id AND c.ward=42 GROUP BY p.district_label ORDER BY p.district_label

SELECT ca.community_area_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.domestic = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS domestic_pct FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON c.community_area_id = ca.community_area_id GROUP BY ca.community_area_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY domestic_pct DESC, ca.community_area_name

SELECT p.district_label, COUNT(*) AS homicide_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts p ON c.district_id=p.district_id WHERE c.primary_type='HOMICIDE' AND c.year=2026 GROUP BY p.district_id, p.district_label ORDER BY rnk

SELECT ca.community_area_name,
 SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', c.crime_date)='2026-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS july_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', c.crime_date)='2026-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS august_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', c.crime_date)='2026-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', c.crime_date)='2026-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM community_areas ca LEFT JOIN crimes c ON c.community_area_id = ca.community_area_id
GROUP BY ca.community_area_id, ca.community_area_name
ORDER BY difference DESC, ca.community_area_name
SELECT driver_code, car_number FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'British'
SELECT race_time_utc FROM races WHERE race_name = 'Belgian Grand Prix'
SELECT circuit_name, locality FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Hungary'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE has_sprint = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'British'

SELECT d.driver_code, c.constructor_name, r.finish_position FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=r.driver_id JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=r.constructor_id WHERE r.round=9 AND r.finish_position BETWEEN 1 AND 10 ORDER BY r.finish_position
SELECT DISTINCT c.circuit_name, c.locality FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuit_id=r.circuit_id WHERE r.has_sprint=1

SELECT d.driver_code, r.constructor_id, r.points, ROUND(100.0*r.points/(SELECT SUM(points) FROM results r2 WHERE r2.round=9 AND r2.constructor_id=r.constructor_id),2) AS pct FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=r.driver_id WHERE r.round=9 AND r.points>0 ORDER BY r.constructor_id, pct DESC

SELECT q.driver_id, q.quali_position, r.finish_position FROM qualifying q LEFT JOIN results r ON r.round=q.round AND r.driver_id=q.driver_id WHERE q.round=9 AND q.quali_position<=5 ORDER BY q.quali_position

SELECT c.constructor_name, ROUND(AVG(p.duration_seconds),2) AS avg_duration FROM pit_stops p JOIN results r ON r.round=p.round AND r.driver_id=p.driver_id JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=r.constructor_id WHERE p.round=9 GROUP BY c.constructor_id ORDER BY avg_duration

SELECT d.driver_code, r.fastest_lap_seconds - (SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_seconds) FROM results WHERE round=9) AS gap_seconds FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=r.driver_id WHERE r.round=9 AND r.fastest_lap_seconds IS NOT NULL AND r.fastest_lap_seconds - (SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_seconds) FROM results WHERE round=9) <= 1.5 ORDER BY gap_seconds, d.driver_code
SELECT AVG(duration_seconds) FROM pit_stops WHERE round=9 AND driver_id='albon'
SELECT race_name, race_date FROM races WHERE round = 11
SELECT given_name, family_name FROM drivers WHERE date_of_birth < '1990-01-01' ORDER BY family_name, given_name

WITH a AS (SELECT driver_id, points FROM results WHERE round=9 UNION ALL SELECT driver_id, points FROM sprint_results WHERE round=9)
SELECT driver_id, SUM(COALESCE(points,0)) AS total_points FROM a GROUP BY driver_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN points>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 ORDER BY total_points DESC, driver_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructors WHERE nationality = 'Italian'
SELECT d.driver_code, r.status FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=r.driver_id WHERE r.round=9 AND r.position_text='R' ORDER BY d.driver_code
SELECT d.driver_code, q.q3_time FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=q.driver_id WHERE q.round=9 AND q.q3_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.q3_time, d.driver_code
SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuit_id=c.circuit_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country

SELECT c.constructor_name, COUNT(ds.driver_id) AS driver_count FROM constructors c JOIN driver_standings ds ON ds.constructor_id=c.constructor_id AND ds.round=9 GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.constructor_name ORDER BY c.constructor_name

WITH t AS (SELECT p.driver_id, SUM(p.duration_seconds) tot FROM pit_stops p WHERE p.round=9 GROUP BY p.driver_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=2)
SELECT c.constructor_name, d.driver_code, ROUND(t.tot,2) total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.constructor_id ORDER BY t.tot DESC) rnk
FROM t JOIN results r ON r.round=9 AND r.driver_id=t.driver_id JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=r.constructor_id JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=t.driver_id
SELECT c.constructor_name, SUM(r.points) AS points FROM results r JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=r.constructor_id WHERE r.round=9 GROUP BY c.constructor_id

SELECT c.constructor_name, d.driver_code, x.standing_position, x.points FROM (SELECT ds.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY constructor_id ORDER BY standing_position, driver_id) rn FROM driver_standings ds WHERE round=9) x JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=x.constructor_id JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=x.driver_id WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY x.standing_position

SELECT r.round, r.race_name,
 (SELECT SUM(points) FROM sprint_results s WHERE s.round=r.round) AS sp,
 (SELECT SUM(points) FROM results x WHERE x.round=r.round) AS rp,
 ROUND(100.0*(SELECT SUM(points) FROM sprint_results s WHERE s.round=r.round)/((SELECT SUM(points) FROM sprint_results s WHERE s.round=r.round)+(SELECT SUM(points) FROM results x WHERE x.round=r.round)),2) AS pct
FROM races r WHERE r.has_sprint=1 ORDER BY r.round

SELECT s.driver_id, s.finish_position AS sprint_finish_position, r.finish_position AS race_finish_position FROM sprint_results s JOIN results r ON s.round = r.round AND s.driver_id = r.driver_id WHERE s.round = 9
SELECT c.constructor_name, COUNT(*) AS top3_finishes FROM results r JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=r.constructor_id WHERE r.round=9 AND r.finish_position<=3 GROUP BY c.constructor_id
SELECT c.constructor_name, MIN(q.q3_time) FROM qualifying q JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) WHERE q.round=9 AND q.q3_time IS NOT NULL AND q.q3_time<>'' GROUP BY c.constructor_name

SELECT c.constructor_name, ROUND(SUM(r.points)*100.0/(SELECT SUM(points) FROM results WHERE round=9),2) AS share FROM results r JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id=r.constructor_id WHERE r.round=9 GROUP BY r.constructor_id HAVING SUM(r.points)>0 ORDER BY share DESC
SELECT driver_id, finish_position, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (grid_position - finish_position) DESC, driver_id) AS gain_rank FROM results WHERE round=9
SELECT firm_name, city FROM firms WHERE state = 'CA' ORDER BY firm_name, firm_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recalls WHERE status = 'Ongoing'
SELECT recall_number, status FROM recalls WHERE initial_firm_notification = 'Press Release' ORDER BY recall_number
SELECT MIN(recall_initiation_date) FROM recalls WHERE status='Ongoing'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE recall_number = 'D-0643-2026'
SELECT e.event_id, e.product_category, COUNT(r.recall_number) FROM events e LEFT JOIN recalls r ON r.event_id = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.product_category ORDER BY e.event_id
SELECT initial_firm_notification, COUNT(*) AS recall_count FROM recalls GROUP BY initial_firm_notification ORDER BY recall_count DESC, initial_firm_notification ASC

SELECT r.classification, ROUND(AVG(julianday(r.report_date)-julianday(r.recall_initiation_date)),1) AS avg_days FROM recalls r LEFT JOIN classifications c ON c.classification=r.classification WHERE r.classification IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.classification ORDER BY c.severity_rank IS NULL, c.severity_rank

SELECT product_category, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN classification IN ('Class I','Class II') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct FROM recalls GROUP BY product_category ORDER BY pct DESC, product_category

WITH c AS (SELECT f.state, f.firm_id, f.firm_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM recalls r JOIN firms f ON f.firm_id=r.firm_id WHERE f.state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.state, f.firm_id, f.firm_name), r AS (SELECT state, firm_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY n DESC, firm_name ASC, firm_id ASC) rn FROM c) SELECT state, firm_name FROM r WHERE rn=1
SELECT product_description FROM products WHERE recall_number = 'D-0689-2026' ORDER BY product_id

WITH t AS (SELECT recall_number, classification, julianday(center_classification_date)-julianday(recall_initiation_date) AS d FROM recalls WHERE center_classification_date IS NOT NULL AND recall_initiation_date IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY classification ORDER BY d DESC, recall_number ASC) rn FROM t) SELECT recall_number, classification, d AS interval_days FROM r WHERE rn=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_type = 'Drugs'
SELECT meaning FROM classifications WHERE classification = 'Class I'
SELECT distribution_pattern FROM recalls WHERE recall_number = 'D-0697-2026'

SELECT f.state, COUNT(DISTINCT f.firm_id) AS num_firms, COUNT(r.recall_number) AS num_recalls FROM firms f LEFT JOIN recalls r ON r.firm_id=f.firm_id WHERE f.state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.state ORDER BY f.state
SELECT product_category, COUNT(*) AS recall_count FROM recalls WHERE voluntary_mandated = 'Voluntary: Firm initiated' GROUP BY product_category ORDER BY recall_count DESC, product_category ASC

SELECT p.product_description, f.firm_name FROM products p JOIN recalls r ON p.recall_number=r.recall_number JOIN firms f ON r.firm_id=f.firm_id WHERE r.recall_initiation_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' ORDER BY r.recall_number, p.product_id
SELECT product_quantity FROM products WHERE product_id = 2

WITH r AS (SELECT recall_number, classification, julianday(report_date)-julianday(center_classification_date) AS d FROM recalls), a AS (SELECT classification, AVG(d) av FROM r GROUP BY classification)
SELECT r.recall_number, r.classification, r.d AS interval_days FROM r JOIN a ON r.classification=a.classification LEFT JOIN classifications c ON c.classification=r.classification WHERE r.d > a.av ORDER BY c.severity_rank, r.d DESC, r.recall_number
SELECT address_1, city, state FROM firms WHERE firm_name = 'CareFusion 213, LLC'

SELECT r.product_category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.classification='Class I' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage FROM products p JOIN recalls r ON p.recall_number = r.recall_number GROUP BY r.product_category ORDER BY percentage DESC, r.product_category ASC
SELECT f.firm_name, COUNT(*) AS recall_count FROM firms f JOIN recalls r ON r.firm_id = f.firm_id GROUP BY f.firm_id ORDER BY recall_count DESC, f.firm_name ASC, f.firm_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recalls r JOIN firms f ON r.firm_id=f.firm_id WHERE f.state='TX'
SELECT r.recall_number, f.firm_name FROM recalls r JOIN firms f ON r.firm_id=f.firm_id WHERE LOWER(r.reason_for_recall) LIKE '%sterility%' ORDER BY r.recall_number

SELECT r.classification, COUNT(*) AS recall_count FROM recalls r LEFT JOIN classifications c ON r.classification=c.classification GROUP BY r.classification ORDER BY c.severity_rank IS NULL, c.severity_rank

SELECT f.firm_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.classification = 'Class I' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct FROM firms f JOIN recalls r ON r.firm_id = f.firm_id GROUP BY f.firm_id ORDER BY pct DESC, f.firm_name ASC, f.firm_id ASC

SELECT f.state, COUNT(*) AS recall_count, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recalls),1) AS pct FROM recalls r JOIN firms f ON r.firm_id=f.firm_id WHERE f.state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.state ORDER BY recall_count DESC, f.state ASC

SELECT recall_number, julianday(report_date) - julianday(recall_initiation_date) AS d FROM recalls WHERE classification='Class II' AND termination_date IS NULL AND recall_initiation_date IS NOT NULL AND report_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d DESC, recall_number ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE severity='Severe' AND category='Met'
SELECT DISTINCT event FROM alerts WHERE office_id='FGZ'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE message_type='Alert' AND urgency='Immediate'
SELECT DISTINCT response FROM alerts WHERE category='Met' AND severity='Severe' ORDER BY response
SELECT MAX(CAST(max_hail_size AS REAL)) FROM alerts WHERE office_id='SLC' AND max_hail_size IS NOT NULL
SELECT zone_type, COUNT(*) FROM zones WHERE state='AK' GROUP BY zone_type ORDER BY zone_type
SELECT DISTINCT o.office_id, o.office_name FROM offices o JOIN alerts a ON a.office_id=o.office_id WHERE a.event='Flash Flood Warning' ORDER BY o.office_id
SELECT event, COUNT(*) AS alert_count, COUNT(DISTINCT office_id) AS office_count FROM alerts GROUP BY event HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY alert_count DESC, event
SELECT z.zone_code, z.zone_name FROM zones z WHERE z.zone_type='county' AND z.state='AZ' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alert_zones az WHERE az.zone_key=z.zone_key) ORDER BY z.zone_code
SELECT event, ROUND(100.0*SUM(urgency='Immediate')/COUNT(*),2) AS pct FROM alerts GROUP BY event HAVING COUNT(*)>=3 ORDER BY pct DESC, event
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zones WHERE zone_type='forecast' AND state='AK'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offices WHERE state='AK'

WITH c AS (SELECT o.region, o.office_id, o.office_name, COUNT(*) cnt FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON a.office_id=o.office_id GROUP BY o.office_id), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY cnt DESC) rk FROM c) SELECT region, office_id, office_name, cnt FROM r WHERE rk=1 ORDER BY region, office_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE response = 'Execute'
SELECT DISTINCT message_type FROM alerts WHERE message_type IS NOT NULL ORDER BY message_type
SELECT a.office_id, o.office_name, COUNT(*) FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON a.office_id=o.office_id WHERE a.max_wind_gust='50 MPH' GROUP BY a.office_id, o.office_name ORDER BY a.office_id
SELECT o.region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.event) FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON a.office_id=o.office_id GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region
SELECT event, COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(CAST(max_hail_size AS REAL)),2) FROM alerts WHERE max_hail_size IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event ORDER BY event

SELECT o.office_id, o.office_name, COUNT(DISTINCT az.zone_key) AS zone_count FROM offices o JOIN alerts a ON a.office_id=o.office_id JOIN alert_zones az ON az.alert_id=a.alert_id GROUP BY o.office_id, o.office_name ORDER BY zone_count DESC, o.office_id

SELECT o.office_id, o.office_name, COUNT(a.alert_id) AS alert_count FROM offices o LEFT JOIN alerts a ON a.office_id = o.office_id GROUP BY o.office_id, o.office_name ORDER BY alert_count DESC, o.office_id

SELECT a.office_id, o.office_name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(a.urgency='Immediate')/COUNT(*),2) AS immediate_pct FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON o.office_id=a.office_id WHERE a.urgency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.office_id, o.office_name HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 ORDER BY immediate_pct DESC, a.office_id

SELECT o.region, ROUND(100.0*SUM(a.severity='Severe')/COUNT(*),2) AS severe_pct FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON a.office_id=o.office_id WHERE a.severity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.region HAVING COUNT(*)>=3 ORDER BY severe_pct DESC, o.region
SELECT a.event, COUNT(DISTINCT az.zone_key) AS affected_zone_count FROM alerts a JOIN alert_zones az ON a.alert_id = az.alert_id GROUP BY a.event ORDER BY affected_zone_count DESC, a.event
SELECT o.region, COUNT(*) AS severe_count FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON a.office_id=o.office_id WHERE a.severity='Severe' GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY severe_count DESC, o.region

SELECT DISTINCT z.zone_code, z.zone_type, z.zone_name FROM alerts a JOIN alert_zones az ON a.alert_id=az.alert_id JOIN zones z ON z.zone_key=az.zone_key WHERE a.office_id='FGZ' AND z.state='AZ' ORDER BY z.zone_code, z.zone_type

WITH d AS (SELECT office_id, alert_id, (julianday(expires)-julianday(sent))*24*60 AS dur FROM alerts WHERE julianday(expires)>julianday(sent)), r AS (SELECT office_id, alert_id, dur, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY office_id ORDER BY dur DESC) rk FROM d) SELECT office_id, alert_id, ROUND(dur,2) AS duration_minutes, rk AS duration_rank FROM r WHERE rk=1 ORDER BY office_id, alert_id

SELECT severity, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE severity IS NOT NULL),2) AS percentage FROM alerts WHERE severity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY severity ORDER BY percentage DESC, severity

SELECT office_id, ROUND(AVG((julianday(expires)-julianday(sent))*24),2) AS avg_hours FROM alerts WHERE office_id IS NOT NULL AND julianday(expires) > julianday(sent) GROUP BY office_id ORDER BY avg_hours DESC, office_id

SELECT o.office_id, o.office_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS alert_rank FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON a.office_id=o.office_id GROUP BY o.office_id, o.office_name ORDER BY alert_rank, o.office_id
SELECT event_id, magnitude FROM events WHERE region_id = 1 AND magnitude >= 3.0 ORDER BY magnitude DESC, event_id ASC
SELECT event_id, event_time, depth_km FROM events WHERE region_id = 2 AND review_status = 'reviewed' AND depth_km < 10.0 ORDER BY event_time ASC
SELECT MAX(significance) AS max_significance FROM events WHERE tsunami_flag = 0 AND magnitude >= 3.0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events WHERE event_type = 'earthquake' AND num_stations >= 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'earthquake'

SELECT r.region_type, ROUND(AVG(e.magnitude),2) AS avg_magnitude FROM events e JOIN regions r ON e.region_id=r.region_id WHERE e.review_status='reviewed' AND e.event_type='earthquake' AND e.magnitude>=3.0 GROUP BY r.region_type ORDER BY r.region_type

SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(AVG(i.community_intensity),2) AS avg_community_intensity FROM events e JOIN event_impacts i ON e.event_id=i.event_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=e.region_id WHERE i.felt_reports>=2 GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY avg_community_intensity DESC, r.region_name ASC

SELECT m.description, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events e JOIN magnitude_types m ON e.mag_type_code=m.mag_type_code WHERE e.tsunami_flag=1 AND e.significance>=100 GROUP BY m.description ORDER BY event_count DESC, m.description ASC

SELECT n.network_name, ROUND(AVG(e.significance),1) AS avg_significance FROM events e JOIN networks n ON n.net_code=e.net_code WHERE e.review_status='reviewed' AND e.magnitude>=3.0 GROUP BY n.network_name ORDER BY avg_significance DESC, n.network_name ASC

SELECT e.event_id, r.region_name, e.magnitude, i.felt_reports FROM events e JOIN event_impacts i ON e.event_id=i.event_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=e.region_id WHERE i.felt_reports >= (SELECT AVG(felt_reports) FROM event_impacts WHERE felt_reports IS NOT NULL)+2 ORDER BY i.felt_reports DESC, e.event_id ASC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(magnitude),2) AS avg_magnitude FROM events WHERE region_id=1 AND mag_type_code='ml'
SELECT AVG(depth_km) FROM events WHERE review_status = 'reviewed' AND magnitude >= 3.0
SELECT MAX(magnitude) AS max_magnitude FROM events WHERE depth_km < 10.0
SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events e JOIN regions r ON e.region_id=r.region_id WHERE e.mag_type_code='ml' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY event_count DESC, r.region_name ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events WHERE num_stations BETWEEN 18 AND 78

SELECT m.description, ROUND(CAST(SUM(e.tsunami_flag=1) AS REAL)/COUNT(*),3) AS tsunami_ratio FROM events e JOIN magnitude_types m ON e.mag_type_code=m.mag_type_code WHERE e.review_status='reviewed' GROUP BY m.mag_type_code, m.description HAVING COUNT(*)>=3 ORDER BY tsunami_ratio DESC, m.description ASC

SELECT n.network_name, MAX(e.significance) AS max_significance FROM events e JOIN networks n ON e.net_code=n.net_code WHERE e.tsunami_flag=0 GROUP BY n.network_name ORDER BY max_significance DESC, n.network_name ASC
SELECT MAX(depth_km) AS max_depth_km FROM events WHERE mag_type_code='mb'

SELECT m.description, ROUND(AVG(e.num_stations),1) AS avg_num_stations FROM events e JOIN magnitude_types m ON e.mag_type_code=m.mag_type_code WHERE e.review_status='reviewed' AND e.num_stations IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.description ORDER BY avg_num_stations DESC, m.description ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events WHERE review_status = 'automatic'

SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(e.num_stations>=50)/COUNT(e.num_stations),1) AS pct_high_stations FROM events e JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=e.region_id WHERE e.num_stations IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING COUNT(e.num_stations)>=2 ORDER BY pct_high_stations DESC, r.region_name ASC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(magnitude),2) AS avg_magnitude FROM events WHERE tsunami_flag = 1

SELECT n.network_name, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events e JOIN networks n ON n.net_code=e.net_code WHERE e.review_status='reviewed' AND e.magnitude>=3.0 GROUP BY n.network_name ORDER BY event_count DESC, n.network_name ASC

SELECT r.region_name, AVG(i.felt_reports) AS avg_felt_reports FROM events e JOIN event_impacts i ON e.event_id=i.event_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=e.region_id WHERE i.felt_reports>0 GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY avg_felt_reports DESC, r.region_name ASC

SELECT n.network_name, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events e JOIN networks n ON e.net_code = n.net_code WHERE e.event_type = 'earthquake' GROUP BY n.network_name ORDER BY event_count DESC, n.network_name ASC

SELECT m.description, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events e JOIN magnitude_types m ON e.mag_type_code=m.mag_type_code WHERE e.review_status='reviewed' AND e.tsunami_flag=0 GROUP BY m.description ORDER BY event_count DESC, m.description ASC

SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status='reviewed' AND e.tsunami_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_reviewed_tsunami FROM events e JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY pct_reviewed_tsunami DESC, r.region_name ASC

SELECT region_name, event_id, magnitude, significance FROM (
SELECT r.region_name, e.event_id, e.magnitude, e.significance,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.region_id ORDER BY e.significance DESC, e.event_id ASC) rn
FROM events e JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=e.region_id) WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY region_name ASC

WITH ra AS (SELECT region_id, AVG(magnitude) AS avg_mag FROM events GROUP BY region_id)
SELECT e.event_id, r.region_name, e.magnitude, ra.avg_mag FROM events e JOIN ra ON e.region_id=ra.region_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=e.region_id
WHERE e.magnitude >= ra.avg_mag + 0.5 ORDER BY r.region_name, e.magnitude DESC, e.event_id
SELECT price FROM transactions WHERE transaction_id = '5834E4E8-5888-29C7-E063-4804A8C015BC'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE new_build_code='N' AND record_status_code='A'
SELECT AVG(price) FROM transactions WHERE tenure_code = 'F'
SELECT p.town_city, COUNT(*) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id = p.property_id WHERE t.price >= 800000 GROUP BY p.town_city ORDER BY p.town_city
SELECT SUM(price) FROM transactions WHERE date_of_transfer='2026-07-10'

SELECT d.district_name, COUNT(t.transaction_id) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id=p.property_id JOIN districts d ON p.district_id=d.district_id WHERE t.ppd_category_code='B' GROUP BY d.district_name ORDER BY d.district_name

SELECT pt.property_type_name, MIN(t.price) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id=p.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code WHERE t.tenure_code='F' GROUP BY pt.property_type_name ORDER BY pt.property_type_name
SELECT MAX(price) FROM transactions WHERE date_of_transfer = '2026-07-20'

SELECT pt.property_type_name, 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN t.tenure_code='L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS leasehold_percentage FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id=p.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code WHERE t.ppd_category_code='A' GROUP BY pt.property_type_name ORDER BY pt.property_type_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE tenure_code = 'L' AND ppd_category_code = 'B'
SELECT MIN(price) FROM transactions WHERE new_build_code='Y' AND record_status_code='A'

SELECT pt.property_type_name, COUNT(t.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM property_types pt LEFT JOIN properties p ON p.property_type_code=pt.property_type_code LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.property_id=p.property_id GROUP BY pt.property_type_code, pt.property_type_name

WITH t AS (SELECT t.price, p.district_id FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON p.property_id=t.property_id WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'),
o AS (SELECT AVG(price) a FROM t)
SELECT d.district_name, AVG(t.price) AS avg_price, AVG(t.price) - (SELECT a FROM o) AS diff
FROM t JOIN districts d ON d.district_id=t.district_id
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.district_name ORDER BY d.district_name

SELECT pt.property_type_name, AVG(t.price) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON p.property_id=t.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code WHERE p.town_city='LONDON' AND t.date_of_transfer='2026-07-17' GROUP BY pt.property_type_name ORDER BY pt.property_type_name

SELECT c.county_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id=p.property_id JOIN districts d ON p.district_id=d.district_id JOIN counties c ON d.county_id=c.county_id WHERE t.ppd_category_code='A' AND t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.county_name ORDER BY c.county_name

SELECT tt.tenure_name, SUM(t.price) AS total_price FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id=p.property_id JOIN tenure_types tt ON tt.tenure_code=t.tenure_code WHERE p.district_id=167 AND t.new_build_code='N' GROUP BY tt.tenure_name ORDER BY tt.tenure_name
SELECT street, town_city FROM properties WHERE property_id = 1

SELECT c.county_name, 100.0*SUM(t.new_build_code='Y')/COUNT(*) AS pct FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id=p.property_id JOIN districts d ON p.district_id=d.district_id JOIN counties c ON d.county_id=c.county_id WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.county_id ORDER BY pct DESC, c.county_name
SELECT property_count FROM postcode_areas WHERE outward_code = 'AL1'

WITH r AS (SELECT pt.property_type_name n, t.transaction_id, t.price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.property_type_name ORDER BY t.price DESC, t.transaction_id ASC) rn FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON p.property_id=t.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31') SELECT n, transaction_id, price FROM r WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY n
SELECT new_build_code, tenure_code FROM transactions WHERE transaction_id = '5834E4E8-588D-29C7-E063-4804A8C015BC'
SELECT tt.tenure_name, SUM(t.price) FROM transactions t JOIN tenure_types tt ON t.tenure_code=tt.tenure_code WHERE t.date_of_transfer='2026-07-17' GROUP BY tt.tenure_name

WITH d AS (SELECT c.county_name, di.district_name, AVG(t.price) AS avg_price FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON p.property_id=t.property_id JOIN districts di ON di.district_id=p.district_id JOIN counties c ON c.county_id=di.county_id WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.county_id, di.district_id), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY county_name ORDER BY avg_price DESC, district_name ASC) rn FROM d) SELECT county_name, district_name, avg_price FROM r WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY county_name
SELECT r.record_status_name, COUNT(t.transaction_id) FROM record_statuses r LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.record_status_code=r.record_status_code GROUP BY r.record_status_code
SELECT new_build_code, AVG(price) FROM transactions WHERE ppd_category_code='A' GROUP BY new_build_code
SELECT MAX(price) FROM transactions WHERE ppd_category_code = 'A'

SELECT pt.property_type_name, AVG(t.price) AS avg_price, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(t.price) DESC) AS rnk FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id=p.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.date_of_transfer)='2026-07' GROUP BY pt.property_type_code, pt.property_type_name

SELECT d.district_name, AVG(t.price) avg_price FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id=p.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code JOIN districts d ON d.district_id=p.district_id WHERE pt.property_type_name='Terraced' AND strftime('%Y-%m', t.date_of_transfer)='2026-07' GROUP BY d.district_id ORDER BY avg_price DESC, d.district_name ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goals WHERE match_id=80 AND player_name='Harry KANE' AND is_own_goal=0
SELECT attendance FROM matches WHERE match_id = 80
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineups WHERE match_id=80 AND is_starter=1
SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(attendance)) AS INTEGER) FROM matches WHERE stage='Round of 32'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goals WHERE match_id=82
SELECT stage, ROUND(AVG(attendance)) AS avg_attendance FROM matches GROUP BY stage ORDER BY stage
SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS yellow_cards FROM cards c JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=c.team_id WHERE c.match_id=81 AND c.card_type='Y' GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name ORDER BY t.team_name
SELECT referee_country, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM matches WHERE referee_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY referee_country ORDER BY match_count DESC, referee_country

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS total_goals FROM goals g JOIN matches m ON g.match_id=m.match_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=g.scoring_team_id WHERE m.went_to_penalties=1 GROUP BY t.team_id ORDER BY total_goals DESC, t.team_name

SELECT s.stadium_name, COUNT(m.match_id) AS match_count FROM stadiums s JOIN matches m ON m.stadium_id=s.stadium_id WHERE s.country='USA' GROUP BY s.stadium_id ORDER BY match_count DESC, s.stadium_name
SELECT match_id, home_ft + away_ft AS total_goals, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY home_ft + away_ft DESC) AS rnk FROM matches ORDER BY rnk, match_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE match_id = 80 AND card_type = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teams WHERE group_letter = 'J'
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(went_to_penalties=1)/COUNT(*),1) FROM matches WHERE stage='Round of 32'
SELECT kickoff_time FROM matches WHERE match_id = 82
SELECT s.country, SUM(m.attendance) AS total_attendance FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id = s.stadium_id GROUP BY s.country ORDER BY total_attendance DESC, s.country
SELECT player_name FROM cards WHERE match_id = 81 ORDER BY player_name
SELECT player_name, COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals WHERE match_id=81 GROUP BY player_name ORDER BY player_name
SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(c.card_id) AS yellow_cards FROM teams t LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.team_id=t.team_id AND c.card_type='Y' WHERE t.group_letter='J' GROUP BY t.team_id ORDER BY t.team_name
SELECT h.team_name, a.team_name FROM matches m JOIN teams h ON h.team_id = m.home_team_id JOIN teams a ON a.team_id = m.away_team_id WHERE m.match_id = 80

SELECT s.country, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN m.went_to_extra_time=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id=s.stadium_id GROUP BY s.country ORDER BY pct DESC, s.country
SELECT t.team_name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(g.is_penalty=1)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct FROM goals g JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=g.scoring_team_id GROUP BY t.team_id ORDER BY pct DESC, t.team_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards c JOIN matches m ON c.match_id=m.match_id JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id=s.stadium_id WHERE s.stadium_name='Atlanta Stadium' AND c.card_type='Y'
SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM matches GROUP BY stage

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS total_goals, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk
FROM goals g JOIN matches m ON g.match_id=m.match_id JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id=s.stadium_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=g.scoring_team_id
WHERE s.stadium_name='Atlanta Stadium' GROUP BY t.team_id ORDER BY rnk, t.team_name
SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals g JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=g.scoring_team_id WHERE g.match_id=81 GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY t.team_name
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(m.went_to_extra_time)/COUNT(*),1) FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON s.stadium_id=m.stadium_id WHERE s.stadium_name='Atlanta Stadium'
SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(g.goal_id) AS REAL)/COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id),2) FROM matches m JOIN stadiums s ON m.stadium_id=s.stadium_id LEFT JOIN goals g ON g.match_id=m.match_id WHERE s.country='USA'

WITH c AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) n FROM goals g JOIN matches m ON g.match_id=m.match_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=g.scoring_team_id WHERE m.went_to_extra_time=1 GROUP BY t.team_id) SELECT team_name, n FROM c WHERE n=(SELECT MAX(n) FROM c) ORDER BY team_name
